Problem Statement: The algorithm iteratively updates parameters by linearizing the inner network model while keeping the outer loss exact. Computes an optimal step size in closed form via a composite proximal framework, eliminating hand-designed schedules.
Assumptions Used: Non-Convex and Smooth Inner with Convex Outer Loss (Deep Frank-Wolfe)
Source References: Berrada et al., "Deep Frank-Wolfe For Neural Network Optimization", ICLR 2019
